links.outcome: Response randomness and omitted or oversimplified information in ChatGPT translations across runs
links.effect: ChatGPT showed some randomness in responses with occasionally over-simplified or neglected information; a more detailed prompt mitigated this.
links.quote: ChatGPT also presents some randomness in its responses with occasionally over-simplified or neglected information, which can be mitigated using a more detailed prompt.

unlisted_practices: Using more detailed prompts (prompt learning) to reduce omissions and variability in LLM report translation
Comparing successive LLM versions (ChatGPT vs GPT-4) for quality of plain-language radiology report translation

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT and GPT-4) translating radiology reports to plain language with radiologist review, and observes the effect of detailed prompting to mitigate omissions.
